scope: Offline Finance OpenBB metadata and query efficiency; no live provider calls, paid data, trading, or Docker qualification.
candidate: Working tree runtime files identified by SHA-256 below; final revision moves exact schema validation into the fresh worker before SDK import.

environment.installation_fingerprint_scope: Sorted installed distribution names, versions, and wheel RECORD contents; unchanged across candidate refinements.

authenticated_http.method: POST /mcp on a real authenticated loopback HTTP server; a fresh private service state for each baseline/candidate run. Warm discovery follows that run's cold status. Query uses a fresh child after discovery.
authenticated_http.source_revision_note: Initial cache measurements preceded the final validation-boundary refinement. Final revision was rerun through qa/test_finance_sdk.py against the source hashes above. Package manifest fingerprint did not change.
authenticated_http.not_measured: A single cold query with no preceding discovery; that path shares one deadline across bootstrap and query rather than receiving separate budgets.

executor_only.method: Call run_isolated (baseline) or CatalogExecutor (initial cache revision) directly; includes process startup, IPC, and shutdown but excludes HTTP/MCP encoding. Do not compare these microsecond metadata figures to authenticated HTTP timings.

memory.query_worker_method: Read each child's /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM every 20 ms until completion; both baseline and candidate query figures use this same method.
memory.source_revision_note: Candidate memory measurements are from the initial cache implementation, before exact schema validation moved exclusively into the child. Final HTTP correctness/timing was rerun, but memory was not resampled after that refinement.
memory.tradeoff: Discovery retains metadata in the server. The one-time bootstrap still needs the full SDK/schema memory peak. No provider responses, credentials, or SDK objects are cached.

baseline_stage_profile.note: Separate process instrumentation of the baseline stages; not an authenticated end-to-end latency measurement.

bounds_and_invalidation.cache_lifetime: One service instance; restart on immutable package deployment; no persistent schema file is accepted.
bounds_and_invalidation.cold_concurrency: One bootstrap under a deadline-aware lock; failed bootstrap is retryable and not cached.
bounds_and_invalidation.query_isolation: Fresh resource-bounded child each time. Exact schema validation and package-fingerprint verification precede SDK import.
bounds_and_invalidation.credential_boundary: Bootstrap gets no provider credentials or MCP token and disables network access. Query workers receive only supported provider credential names in a clean environment.
bounds_and_invalidation.stale_installation: Fresh query checks installed distribution/RECORD fingerprint; mismatch returns catalog_stale and invalidates cached metadata for retry.

skip_reasons: QuantLib is optional in the OpenBB environment; covered in the advanced environment below.
Installed SDK test is opt-in; enabled and run separately below.

limitations: Individual development-host measurements, not medians, service-level objectives, or production capacity guarantees. OS file caches were not deliberately flushed.
No live provider reachability, entitlement, quota, freshness, or paid-data outcome was tested.
All installed providers still import for a fresh data query. Namespace restriction narrows access but does not selectively unload provider packages.
Existing upstream provider disk caches are separate from this schema-only service cache; no new financial-result cache was introduced.
In-place edits to installed package source are unsupported; deploy immutable packages and restart the service.
Cold first queries consume one total deadline for discovery plus query execution. Run openbb_status after deployment to check installed readiness before a provider read.
